obligation: Sponsor must own and control DAF assets; legal control cannot sit with an administrator, software provider or donor
citation: IRC 4966(d)(2)(A)(ii) 'owned and controlled by a sponsoring organization'; Unbound GOV-AUTH core boundary; CNV-LEG-001
who_can_satisfy: sponsor board and officers
minimum_coverage: Board retains control continuously; officers appointed with written authority
limitations: TPA/Echelon staff cannot hold this control (CNV-GOV-004 bars vendor staff from A3+); AI agents hold no legal authority
notes: Definitional: a fund not owned/controlled by the sponsor is not a DAF. Statute does not say how control is exercised day to day. Effort is ASSUMPTION.

obligation: Contemporaneous written acknowledgment for each DAF contribution stating the sponsor has exclusive legal control over contributed assets
citation: IRC 170(f)(18)(B); Unbound CNV-PAY-006 (fee treatment); WL-21
who_can_satisfy: sponsor (issuer of record); TPA/software may generate under sponsor-approved template
minimum_coverage: Per contribution, automated; template approved by sponsor counsel at adoption and on change
limitations: Template wording and gift-date/valuation rules need counsel; non-cash and complex assets need human review
notes: Per-item human signature not required by statute (INFERENCE). Valuation/qualified-appraisal rules for non-cash gifts not researched here.

obligation: Sponsor retains final authority over every DAF distribution; donor/advisor input is advisory only
citation: IRC 4966(d)(2)(A)(iii) 'advisory privileges'; 170(f)(18)(B) exclusive legal control; Unbound GOV-AUTH-002; CNV-GRT-001; WL D7
who_can_satisfy: sponsor board, or officer/committee delegated by board resolution
minimum_coverage: Board resolution adopting policy and naming delegate and exception reviewer; renewed at least annually (CNV-GOV-008 12-month expiry)
limitations: Statute does not define how much per-grant human involvement 'control' requires; Unbound vendor staff cannot be the delegate
notes: Authority must be the sponsor's; execution may be delegated. See CO-004 for whether each grant needs a human.

obligation: Whether each conforming grant needs an individual human approval, or may be approved by a board-adopted deterministic policy
citation: No statute or regulation found requiring per-grant human sign-off; Unbound CNV-GRT-001 (policy approval only after board delegation), CNV-GOV-008 (quarterly board report and sampled reviews)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor-named delegate; policy engine executes under that authority
minimum_coverage: Human: board adoption of policy version, exception review, quarterly sampled review; routine conforming items automated
limitations: No IRS guidance found on automated approval; counsel must confirm corporate-law delegation and 4966 fund-manager exposure for the delegate
notes: Research view: automation under sponsor-approved policy appears permissible; it is not established. Effort ASSUMPTION.

obligation: Prevent taxable distributions: no grants to natural persons, for non-170(c)(2)(B) purposes, or to non-exempt recipients without expenditure responsibility
citation: IRC 4966(a),(c); Unbound CNV-GRT-002, CNV-GRT-003, CA-180-01..18
who_can_satisfy: software eligibility checks under sponsor policy; humans for exceptions
minimum_coverage: Every grant checked against current recipient status at approval and release; exceptions to human
limitations: Data sources lag; status unknown must not equal eligible; the 180-day cycle is policy not law
notes: Check is deterministic for 170(b)(1)(A) public charities; judgement concentrated in exceptions. Effort ASSUMPTION.

obligation: Identify disqualified supporting organizations (e.g., Type III non-functionally-integrated, or supporting orgs controlled by donor) before granting
citation: IRC 4966(c)(2)(A) exceptions exclude disqualified supporting organizations; Unbound CNV-GRT-002; competitive-displacement 24 (non-public certification evidence)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor grants/compliance staff or outsourced compliance provider
minimum_coverage: Human review whenever recipient is a supporting organization lacking clear public evidence
limitations: Requires non-public evidence (certifications, organizing documents); AI may gather but not certify
notes: Exact definition of 'disqualified supporting organization' sits in 4966(d)(4); read with counsel.

obligation: Exercise expenditure responsibility (pre-grant inquiry, signed agreement, grantee reports, return reporting) for DAF grants that require it
citation: IRC 4966(c)(1)(B)(ii) (by reference to 4945(h)); 26 CFR 53.4945-5(b)-(d); Unbound CNV-GRT-008
who_can_satisfy: sponsor compliance staff or external counsel/grants consultant
minimum_coverage: Each ER grant: pre-grant inquiry, agreement, annual and final reports, Form 990 disclosure
limitations: Judgement-heavy; Unbound release 1 may simply disable ER grants (low volume)
notes: Regulation is written for private foundations; 4966 imports the 4945(h) standard. Release-1 option: block ER grant types. Effort ASSUMPTION.

obligation: Name the sponsor's fund managers (officers, directors, trustees, employees with authority) and ensure they do not knowingly agree to taxable or prohibited-benefit distributions
applies_to: sponsor; individual fund managers (5%/10% personal taxes)
citation: IRC 4966(a)(2), 4966(d)(3); 4967(a)(2); Unbound CNV-GRT-001 (records 4966(d)(3) managers per policy version), CNV-GOV-004
who_can_satisfy: sponsor officers/directors; contracted officers appointed by board
minimum_coverage: Named roster maintained at all times; acknowledgment on appointment
limitations: An Echelon employee given final approval authority could become exposed or conflicted; keep vendor staff out of A3+
notes: Whether a contracted (non-employee) appointed officer is a 'fund manager' needs counsel; statute says officer/director/trustee 'or similar powers'.

obligation: Prevent distributions that confer more than incidental benefit on a donor, advisor, family member or 35%-controlled entity
citation: IRC 4967(a),(b); 4958(f)(7); Unbound CNV-GRT-009; WL-09, WL-10, D8
who_can_satisfy: donor affirmation (automated capture); sponsor compliance for ambiguous cases
minimum_coverage: Affirmation per grant/standing affirmation; human review of disclosed benefits
limitations: AI cannot affirm on donor's behalf; 'more than incidental' requires judgement
notes: Human required only for flagged/ambiguous cases (INFERENCE).

obligation: Block any grant, loan, compensation or similar payment from a DAF to a donor, advisor, family member or 35%-controlled entity (automatic excess benefit)
who_can_satisfy: deterministic related-party payee block; human resolves matches
minimum_coverage: Every payment instruction screened against fund's related-party set
limitations: Related-party data quality depends on donor disclosures
notes: Deterministic control; human handles match exceptions.

obligation: Treat sponsor-compensated investment advisors to DAF assets as disqualified persons; keep their compensation reasonable and approved by disinterested board
citation: IRC 4958(f)(1)(F), (f)(8); repo data/sponsor-governance-controls-2026.csv O10 (vendor employees on sponsor board)
who_can_satisfy: disinterested sponsor directors; independent compensation benchmarking by external advisor
minimum_coverage: Annual review of advisor contracts by disinterested directors
limitations: Echelon/Unbound affiliates on a sponsor board create conflict questions (cf. RCF/Ren O10); rebuttable-presumption procedure under 4958 regs not re-read here
notes: Applies to investment advisors; whether a technology/administration vendor can be a 4958(f)(8) or (f)(1)(A) person depends on facts (INFERENCE).

obligation: Report DAF count, year-end value, contributions and grants on Form 990 Schedule D Part I; file Form 990 signed by an officer
citation: IRC 6033(k); Form 990 Schedule D instructions Part I; Unbound CNV-FIN-009 (Schedule D bridge)
who_can_satisfy: software produces data; outsourced CPA prepares; sponsor officer signs
minimum_coverage: Annual; officer signature; reconciles to audited statements
limitations: Officer signature cannot be delegated to vendor or AI (INFERENCE from return signature practice; signature rule not re-read this pass)
notes: Schedule D Part I line content verified from IRS instructions; officer-signature point is INFERENCE.

obligation: Maintain sponsor status as a 170(c) organization that is not a private foundation (and not a non-functionally-integrated Type III) so DAF contributions remain deductible
who_can_satisfy: sponsor finance with outsourced CPA (public support schedule)
minimum_coverage: Annual public support computation and review
limitations: Loss of status is a sponsor-level event no vendor control can cure
notes: Schedule A mechanics not re-read here (INFERENCE).

obligation: Track the November 2023 proposed DAF regulations (REG-142338-07) as proposed, not final; decide sponsor policy on any voluntary early conformance
citation: 88 FR 77922 (2023-11-14) proposed rule; Council on Foundations page updated 2026-05-08 states not yet finalized; Unbound CNV-GRT-008, CNV-GRT-009
who_can_satisfy: sponsor counsel; Unbound product compliance monitors
minimum_coverage: Quarterly rule-watch check; counsel review on finalization
limitations: Not binding; finalization status after 2026-05-08 unverified
notes: Proposed rules would, if finalized, affect the advisor/investment-advisor and fund definitions.

obligation: Keep books and records showing compliance and supporting returns for as long as they may be material (statute of limitations); 7 years is practice
citation: IRC 6001 (general duty, not re-read); IRS EO recordkeeping page; Unbound CNV-PLT-004 (10-year floor for transaction records)
who_can_satisfy: software retention with sponsor-approved schedule
minimum_coverage: Retention schedule approved by sponsor compliance owner; legal holds override
limitations: IRS page states no fixed period; 7 years is practice; OFAC needs 10 years (CO-020)
notes: Unbound applies 10-year floor to all transaction records to cover OFAC.

obligation: Do not provide funds or services to, or deal in property of, blocked persons; block property in sponsor's possession or control
applies_to: sponsor; TPA and all U.S. persons in the chain
citation: 31 CFR Chapter V sanctions programs; 31 CFR 501.603 (holder of blocked property); Unbound CNV-GRT-006
who_can_satisfy: automated screening with human disposition
minimum_coverage: Every counterparty screened at onboarding, on list change and pre-release
limitations: Civil liability is commonly described as strict liability (not verified in fetched text); screening tooling is the means, not itself the legal duty
notes: Primary responsibility remains with the holder (sponsor) even when an agent files reports.

obligation: Screen donors, advisors, successors, grantees and payors at onboarding, delta-screen on list updates, and screen before each release
citation: OFAC Framework (internal controls); Unbound CNV-GRT-006
who_can_satisfy: software screening service
minimum_coverage: Continuous; list version recorded per release
limitations: Name-matching quality and list freshness; vendor list feeds
notes: Method is risk-based; the prohibition is the law.

obligation: Disposition of potential matches (block, reject, proceed/false positive) by an authorized person
citation: OFAC Framework (internal controls, escalation); Unbound CNV-GRT-006 (never auto-Blocked; human dispositions reusable 12 months)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor compliance officer (may be fractional/contracted) or external sanctions counsel; AI prepares dossier
minimum_coverage: Same-day to 2-business-day review of true-match candidates; backup approver
limitations: AI may rank and summarize but a human makes block/reject decisions
notes: Volume depends on name-matching threshold.

obligation: File blocked-property reports within 10 business days, rejected-transaction reports within 10 business days, and annual blocked-property report (as of June 30, due September 30)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor compliance officer; attorney or agent may file but responsibility stays with holder
minimum_coverage: Event-driven 10-business-day clock; annual report by September 30 if any blocked property
limitations: Agent filing does not shift responsibility

obligation: Retain OFAC transaction records for at least 10 years (blocked property: while blocked plus 10 years)
applies_to: sponsor; any person engaging in covered transactions
citation: 31 CFR 501.601; Unbound CNV-PLT-004
who_can_satisfy: software retention
minimum_coverage: Continuous
limitations: Applies to Unbound too if it engages in covered transactions (INFERENCE)

obligation: Maintain a risk-based sanctions compliance program: management commitment, risk assessment, internal controls, testing/auditing, training
applies_to: sponsor; TPA (as organization subject to U.S. jurisdiction)
citation: OFAC 'A Framework for OFAC Compliance Commitments' (2019) - guidance used in enforcement evaluation
who_can_satisfy: sponsor compliance officer; Echelon compliance owner for Unbound's own program
minimum_coverage: Named sanctions compliance officer; annual risk assessment; training at least annually
limitations: Guidance, not regulation; OFAC footnote says officer may also hold other compliance roles
notes: Framework footnote: compliance officer 'may be the same person serving in other senior compliance positions' - supports fractional/shared role.

obligation: Independent testing/audit of the sanctions compliance program
citation: OFAC Framework, Testing and Auditing I ('independent of the audited activities and functions')
who_can_satisfy: external compliance consultant, internal audit, or sponsor staff not operating screening
minimum_coverage: Periodic (annual is common practice)
limitations: Person who designs/operates screening cannot test it
notes: Annual cadence is practice, not stated as mandatory.

obligation: Apply Treasury anti-terrorist-financing best practices for foreign or high-risk grantees (due diligence, monitoring)
citation: Treasury Anti-Terrorist Financing Guidelines: Voluntary Best Practices for U.S.-Based Charities (71 FR 63838, 2006-10-31); Unbound CNV-GRT-007, CNV-GRT-008
who_can_satisfy: sponsor compliance or external counsel
minimum_coverage: Per foreign/high-risk grant
limitations: Explicitly voluntary; does not create safe harbor; release 1 may route foreign grants via intermediaries
notes: Low relevance if foreign direct grants are disabled.

obligation: Bank Secrecy Act AML program and SAR/CTR duties
citation: 31 USC 5312(a)(2) lists financial institutions; no category names charities or DAF sponsors
who_can_satisfy: n/a unless an entity falls in a listed category
minimum_coverage: None identified for sponsor acting as grantmaker
limitations: A party that transmits funds as a business can be a money transmitter (5312(a)(2)(R)); catch-all designation possible
notes: Research view: a DAF sponsor making its own grants through banks is not a BSA financial institution. Banks apply BSA/CIP to the sponsor as customer.

obligation: Avoid becoming a money transmitter (federal MSB and state licensing) by never holding or transmitting sponsor/donor funds
citation: 31 USC 5312(a)(2)(R); FinCEN FIN-2013-R002 (payment processor exemption, conditions); Unbound CNV-LEG-001; servicing-economics CST-C08 / ADV-032
who_can_satisfy: external regulatory counsel (one-time opinion), Echelon compliance owner monitors funds-flow conformance
minimum_coverage: Opinion before activation; automated funds-flow conformance check per deployment
limitations: State money-transmission laws vary; any FBO/pooled account or payment-execution capability changes the answer
notes: Launch gate per servicing-economics 07/08. Effort ASSUMPTION.

obligation: Record ACH roles per program: Originator (sponsor), ODFI, Third-Party Service Provider (Unbound if it creates files), any Third-Party Sender
citation: Nacha 'Third Parties in the ACH Network' (TPSP 'may or may not transmit entries directly'); Unbound CNV-PAY-001; competitive-displacement CHL-037, CHL-066, OQ-009
who_can_satisfy: sponsor treasury + Unbound compliance owner; ODFI confirms
minimum_coverage: Per program at setup and on change
limitations: Nacha Rules bind through bank agreements; TPS status (if sponsor's agreement is with Unbound) changes obligations materially
notes: Research view (CHL-037): a platform that builds the sponsor's ACH file is a TPSP.

obligation: Annual Nacha Rules Compliance Audit covering the ACH functions the TPSP performs
applies_to: TPA (as TPSP); sponsor's ODFI audits its own
citation: Nacha Operating Rules Article One 1.2.2 (annual audit, consolidated 2019-01-01); Nacha Third Parties page
who_can_satisfy: external payments auditor (e.g., payments association audit service) or qualified internal auditor
minimum_coverage: Annually
limitations: Nacha text read does not specify auditor independence; ODFIs commonly request proof; competitive-displacement models ~$44-50k/yr
notes: Fixed deadline (historically December 31) not confirmed on current Nacha page.

obligation: Third-Party Sender risk assessment of its ACH activities (cannot rely on another TPS's assessment)
applies_to: TPA only if it is a Third-Party Sender
citation: Nacha Third Parties page; Nacha RMAG material (search result) on non-reliance
who_can_satisfy: Echelon compliance owner with external payments advisor
minimum_coverage: Annually if TPS
limitations: Not triggered if sponsor contracts directly with ODFI (Unbound CNV-PAY-001 design)

obligation: Risk-based processes reasonably intended to identify ACH entries suspected unauthorized or authorized under False Pretenses; review at least annually
citation: Nacha Risk Management Topics - Fraud Monitoring Phase 1 (2026-03-20, >=6M volume) and Phase 2 (2026-06-19, practical 2026-06-22, no threshold); Unbound CNV-PAY-001; CHL-038
who_can_satisfy: automated monitoring rules; human annual review by sponsor treasury and Unbound compliance owner
minimum_coverage: Continuous automated monitoring; documented annual review by each party for its role
limitations: Each party owns its own process; does not require per-entry pre-screening
notes: Applies to credit Originators (grants), not only debits.

obligation: Render deposit account data unreadable when stored electronically
applies_to: TPA/TPS above 2M ACH transactions/year (mandatory); below threshold practice
citation: Nacha Third Parties page (security requirement >2M transactions)
who_can_satisfy: engineering control (encryption)
minimum_coverage: Continuous
limitations: Threshold-dependent; SOC 2 and state law (CO-050) expect it anyway

obligation: Apply Notifications of Change within the Nacha window and match returns on trace/reason codes
citation: Nacha Operating Rules (NOC timing as recorded in Unbound CNV-PAY-002: six banking days or before next entry); CNV-PAY-005
who_can_satisfy: software under change control
minimum_coverage: Each NOC/return
limitations: Unmatched returns go to a human queue
notes: NOC timing taken from Unbound requirement text, not re-read in Nacha Rules this pass.

obligation: ODFI origination agreement, exposure limits and security procedures for payment release
citation: UCC 4A-202(b)-(c) commercially reasonable security procedures (wires); Nacha ODFI-Originator agreement requirements (not re-read)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor treasury officers named in bank agreement
minimum_coverage: Named authorized users; bank-required controls
limitations: Declining a bank-offered procedure can shift wire-fraud loss to the customer (4A-202(c))
notes: Bank may contractually require dual control; terms vary by bank.

obligation: Dual (two-person) authorization of payment release
applies_to: sponsor; TPA where it prepares releases
citation: No statute, regulation or Nacha rule found requiring dual authorization; COSO Principle 10 (segregate incompatible duties or use alternative controls); bank agreements may require it; Unbound CNV-GOV-003 (three-distinct-person rule until deterministic gate accepted)
who_can_satisfy: preparer and releaser distinct; releaser may be sponsor officer; deterministic gate may replace one human only after auditor/board acceptance
minimum_coverage: Every release batch; backup releaser for absence
limitations: Two Echelon staff do not give independence from Echelon; best second party is sponsor personnel
effort_unit: hours/year (daily batch approvals ~10 min x 250 days, ASSUMPTION)
notes: Classified AUDITOR-EXPECTATION + INDUSTRY-PRACTICE; becomes CONTRACTUAL where the bank agreement or sponsor MSA requires it; ECHELON-POLICY in Unbound.

obligation: Positive pay with daily issue files (including voids) on every check-disbursement account
citation: UCC 3-406/4-406 loss allocation; Cincinnati Ins. v. Wachovia (deposit agreement preclusion where positive pay declined); Unbound CNV-PAY-002
who_can_satisfy: software sends issue file; sponsor treasury decides exceptions daily
minimum_coverage: Daily exception decision by bank cutoff
limitations: Bank product and fee required; exception decisions need an authorized human
notes: Not law, but deposit agreements can shift check-fraud loss to customers who decline it.

obligation: Independently verify charity bank details before first electronic payment and after any change (bank account-owner match or document plus callback to independently sourced contact)
citation: Unbound CNV-PAY-002, CA-180-11, UNB-RCN-GRT-017; supports Nacha fraud-monitoring duty (CO-029)
who_can_satisfy: automated account-owner match; human callback by person independent of change request
minimum_coverage: Every new/changed destination
limitations: Callback must not use contact data from the change request
notes: Independence here = independent channel, not independent organization.

obligation: Report and remit uncashed grant checks as unclaimed property after the state dormancy period; do not void to avoid escheat
citation: State unclaimed property laws (dormancy varies, e.g., NY vendor checks 3 years); NY OSC escheat guidance; Unbound CNV-PAY-003
who_can_satisfy: sponsor finance with outsourced unclaimed-property service
minimum_coverage: Annual state reports where items exist; due diligence letters
limitations: Rules differ by state and property type; whether grant checks to charities are exempt is unverified
notes: State statute rows needed (CNV-PAY-003).

obligation: Merchant/processor agreement duties for card or online contributions (card-brand rules, data security)
citation: Processor agreements (not reviewed); Unbound CNV-PAY-006, CNV-PAY-008 (cards deferred)
who_can_satisfy: processor-hosted payment pages; sponsor contract owner
minimum_coverage: Annual contract/attestation as processor requires
limitations: Deferred in Unbound release 1
notes: No processor contract read this pass.

obligation: Independent CPA audit when state thresholds are met (CA: gross revenue >= $2M, within 9 months, plus board audit committee; NY: > $1M audit, $250k-$1M review)
citation: Cal. Gov. Code 12586(e); NY Exec. Law 172-b; NY AG Charities Bureau presentation 2026-06-03
who_can_satisfy: external CPA firm only
minimum_coverage: Annually
limitations: Auditor must be independent of sponsor and cannot also operate its controls; Uniform Guidance single audit only if federal awards (N/A expected)
notes: Most DAF sponsors exceed these thresholds.

obligation: Board audit committee (CA-registered charities required to have audits); composition limits vs finance committee
citation: Cal. Gov. Code 12586(e)(2); CA AG Nonprofit Integrity Act guidance (2004)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor directors (non-staff)
minimum_coverage: Meets to select auditor and review audit
limitations: Vendor-affiliated directors weaken independence

obligation: Daily/continuous bank, custody and ledger reconciliation with exception resolution
citation: No statute found; COSO Principle 10; Unbound CNV-FIN-004 (continuous, exact match auto-pass), GOV-AUTH-014
who_can_satisfy: automated matching; exceptions by a person outside the payment chain (sponsor finance, outsourced bookkeeper/CPA, or shared Echelon accountant with no release rights)
minimum_coverage: Daily automated; exceptions within sponsor-set business days
limitations: Agent that initiates cannot attest settlement (GOV-AUTH-014); reconciler must lack payment initiation/approval rights
notes: Independence is functional (role separation), not organizational.

obligation: Monthly independent review and controller sign-off of reconciliation completeness
citation: Unbound CNV-FIN-004 (monthly controller sign-off), CNV-GOV-003 (at least monthly independent review); AUDITOR-EXPECTATION
who_can_satisfy: sponsor controller or fractional controller/CPA engaged by sponsor
minimum_coverage: Monthly
limitations: If the controller is Echelon staff and also supervises payment preparation, independence fails
notes: Auditor acceptance needed for who signs.

obligation: Segregate incompatible duties (request, approve, record, release, reconcile) across humans, service accounts and agents; use documented alternative controls where impractical
citation: COSO 2013 Principle 10 point of focus (segregation or alternative control activities); Unbound GOV-AUTH-004, CNV-GOV-003
who_can_satisfy: engine-enforced roles; humans from at least two parties for release and reconciliation
minimum_coverage: Continuous enforcement; quarterly access review
limitations: Small teams cannot segregate internally; sponsor or external personnel supply the second party
notes: COSO wording taken from AAA compendium (secondary).

obligation: Provide SOC 1 Type 2 (AT-C 320) covering controls relevant to sponsors' ICFR, or allow user auditors to test directly
citation: AICPA SOC 1 description; AU-C 402 (user auditor obtains understanding/evidence of service-org controls; analog ASA 402); Unbound CNV-GOV-001 (Type 2 period started before first staffed go-live)
who_can_satisfy: independent CPA service auditor
minimum_coverage: Annual Type 2 period; bridge letters for gaps
limitations: Not law; contractual once in MSA; service auditor must be independent of Echelon
notes: Sponsor's auditor decides reliance approach; confirm in writing (CNV-GOV-001 gate).

obligation: Provide SOC 2 Type 2 (Trust Services Criteria) for security/availability/confidentiality
citation: Typical sponsor/bank vendor due diligence; Unbound SOC2 directive (ECHELON-POLICY); CNV-GOV-001
who_can_satisfy: independent CPA firm
minimum_coverage: Annual
limitations: Not a legal requirement; often combined with SOC 1

obligation: Perform complementary user entity controls assumed in the TPA's SOC report (e.g., approve policy versions, review own users' access, review exception reports)
citation: AU-C 402 / ASA 402 (user auditor evaluates relevant CUECs); Unbound CUEC-CNV-GOV-003/004/005
who_can_satisfy: sponsor personnel
minimum_coverage: As specified per CUEC (quarterly access review, monthly report review)
limitations: Cannot be performed by the service organization itself

obligation: Monitor subservice organizations' SOC reports (bank, custodian, cloud) and obtain bridge letters
citation: Unbound CNV-GOV-002 (3-month gap default labelled practice)
who_can_satisfy: Echelon compliance owner (fractional); sponsor finance
minimum_coverage: Annual per vendor plus gap alerts
limitations: Practice thresholds, not standards

obligation: Two-approver change control (neither the author) for control-relevant modules; signed builds; break-glass admin
citation: Unbound CNV-PLT-010; AUDITOR-EXPECTATION for SOC 1 ITGCs
who_can_satisfy: engineers other than the author; one approver may be shared Echelon engineer
minimum_coverage: Every control-relevant change
limitations: Founder-led team: author+2 approvers requires >=3 qualified people or external reviewer

obligation: Periodic review of privileged and authority assignments (role changes, departures)
citation: Unbound GOV-AUTH-025, GOV-AUTH-020
who_can_satisfy: reviewer not the administrator of the access
minimum_coverage: Quarterly (practice)
limitations: Automation compiles; human attests

obligation: GLBA/FTC Safeguards Rule (Qualified Individual, written program, breach notice to FTC)
citation: FTC Act 15 USC 44 'corporation' = organized for profit (nonprofit sponsors likely outside FTC jurisdiction); FTC Safeguards guidance
who_can_satisfy: n/a for nonprofit sponsor (likely); for Echelon depends on whether it is 'significantly engaged in financial activities' or a service provider to one
minimum_coverage: If applicable: named Qualified Individual, annual board report
limitations: Applicability to a for-profit DAF administrator unresolved
notes: Practical design meets Safeguards elements anyway via SOC 2.

obligation: State data-security laws: written information security program and service-provider oversight (MA 201 CMR 17.00), reasonable safeguards (NY GBL 899-bb, scaled for small businesses)
applies_to: sponsor; TPA (both own/license or maintain residents' personal information)
citation: 201 CMR 17.00; NY GBL 899-bb; NY AG SHIELD page
who_can_satisfy: Echelon security owner (fractional vCISO acceptable); sponsor oversees TPA by contract
minimum_coverage: Designated program owner; annual review; vendor contracts with security terms
limitations: MA text not fetched (403); 'designate employees' wording is from prior knowledge; nonprofit status not an exemption found

obligation: State breach notification to residents/regulators after unauthorized acquisition of personal information
citation: State breach laws (e.g., MA notification requirements; NY GBL 899-aa)
who_can_satisfy: sponsor counsel decides notice; Echelon incident lead; external breach counsel
minimum_coverage: Incident response plan; annual tabletop
limitations: Deadlines and triggers differ by state; legal judgement required
notes: Per-state deadlines not tabulated here.

obligation: Named security owner with escalation to sponsor audit/risk committee
citation: Unbound CNV-GOV-003 (CISO direct access to audit and risk committee); SOC 2 CC1 (practice)
who_can_satisfy: fractional vCISO or Echelon security lead
minimum_coverage: Continuous ownership; quarterly report
limitations: Shared across Echelon products is acceptable if time is allocated and conflicts recorded

obligation: Sponsor charitable registration and annual reporting with state AGs where it solicits; subject to AG oversight of charitable assets
citation: Cal. Gov. Code 12586 (registration/reporting); NY Exec. Law 172-b; Unbound CNV-GRT-015
who_can_satisfy: sponsor; outsourced registration service or counsel
minimum_coverage: Annual per state
limitations: Multi-state burden; AG may inquire into vendor relationships

obligation: Charitable fundraising platform registration (California Gov. Code 12599.9; Hawaii HRS 467B-2.3) before white-label/embedded or charity-side donation features
applies_to: TPA (Unbound) if it operates a covered platform
citation: Unbound CNV-LEG-002 (repo-sourced; statutes not re-read this pass)
who_can_satisfy: Echelon compliance owner with counsel
minimum_coverage: Annual renewal where registered
limitations: Release 1 avoids by sponsor-branded-only scope
notes: Repo citation only.

obligation: Prudent management of sponsor investments; UPMIFA applicability to DAFs uncertain; general nonprofit fiduciary duty applies
citation: UPMIFA (state enactments); MN AG handbook; secondary source states UPMIFA may not apply to DAFs
who_can_satisfy: sponsor investment committee; external RIA/OCIO
minimum_coverage: Investment policy adopted; at least annual manager review (practice)
